arguments.summary: The p99 latency spike was due to issues with the pgbouncer connection pool. The service status is currently degraded, with 100 connections in use and no worker throughput. The failed_jobs backlog in the jobs database has been growing, and the export using pg_dump is in progress. The export will be ready in about 20 minutes.
arguments.recommended_next_step: Monitor the pgbouncer service status and performance. Once the pg_dump export is complete, review the failed_jobs table for any actionable insights. Implement a solution to manage the connection pool effectively to prevent future issues.
